metadata.cpu_process_scope: Performance.TIME_PROCESS * 1000; engine process time, not OS CPU utilization
metadata.gpu_ms_scope: per_viewport_only; not a whole presented frame; gpu_ms is unavailable
metadata.sampling: frame_post_draw wall-clock intervals; includes host overlay and sampler overhead
metadata.viewport_timing_scope: RenderingServer last available viewport render work; not presentation wall time

reproducibility.limitations: Host sets global seed before scene construction; local RNG seeds and physics/tick scheduling are not overridden; demo input varies with frame timing
